priority_condition: Review only after the current unaligned-pipeline experiment completes; collect HeadTile-specific PMU before deciding to implement.
scope: Existing general HeadTileRotary dispatch: nonaligned even D<=64, many heads. Public shape/dtype/alignment parameters only; no hidden testcase mapping.
source_observation: HeadTileRotary currently gathers compact C/S over padded half-pairs, gathers low/high input halves, computes four products and Sub/Add, then gathers results back to the flat layout. Five Gather calls process about6*capacity elements total.
naive_rewrite_rejected_by_model: Simply gathering full C/S and one rotate-half vector changes five Gather calls to three, but still processes about6*capacity elements. Fewer calls alone is not a proven throughput improvement.
hypothesis: Use a flat rotate-half representation together with alignment-period coefficient expansion. Build only a short aligned coefficient prefix with Gather; replicate that prefix using supported vector Copy repeats instead of gathering coefficients for every head.

alignment_model.period_heads: 8/gcd(D,8) for FP32 coefficient storage aligned to32 bytes
alignment_model.prefix_elements: U=period_heads*D; for even D<=64, period<=4 and U<=256
alignment_model.expansion: Generate current-token coefficients on Device for one prefix; repeat-copy the immutable prefix with srcRepStride0 and dstRepStrideU/8. Handle the final partial head group with a valid mask.
alignment_model.example_D30_H128: period4, U120. Old coefficient gathers process2*128*16=4096 elements. New prefix gathers process240 elements plus roughly7440 coefficient elements copied with regular vector access. Rotation uses one full-input Gather instead of low/high input plus final packing gathers.
alignment_model.important_caveat: Gather and Copy have different costs; these are logical element counts, not measured bandwidth/cycles or a speedup forecast. Confirm installed Copy API alignment/repeat/overlap constraints before coding.

dataflow_candidate: Generate unchanged FP32 sin/cos into compact scratch before loading x; create signed sin base with lower-half negative and upper-half positive values
Gather a short full-layout C/S prefix using Device-generated geometry indices, then expand its aligned period with Copy
Load/cast the flat input; Gather one rotate-half vector into sufficiently sized output-queue scratch
Compute two full-vector products and an addition, preserving the original per-output FP32 product/add order; do not lower precision or assume fused arithmetic
Use a separate result vector before FP16 output cast so no unsupported shrinking in-place cast is needed; keep position0 as exact input identity
memory_model: Let capacity=tileHeads*pitch. Existing dominant allocations are6capacity FP32 work +5capacity uint32 indices +four queue slots of2capacity elements. A prototype can retain the same work, use one2capacity rotate-index map plus two short-prefix maps, and enlarge FP16 output slots to hold FP32 scratch. Verify all lifetimes, frequency fallback workspace, masks and tails; do not blindly reuse this estimate as an allocation proof.
required_evidence: Review prior GatherMask/head-packing and layout_copy negatives and explain the different alignment/dataflow
Measure the existing HeadTile path on both FP16 and FP32 and distinguish Gather throughput, scalar setup, barriers and DMA
Prove prefix and rotation maps cover every valid element and never read beyond allocated storage; no Host tensor work or stored results
Preserve all original precision gates, finite output bits and position0 bits; explicitly check nonzero-position nonfinite classes and signed-zero behavior of Sub versus Add with negated sin
Source-bound normal/audit/launch/template tests and native balanced controls before any platform trial
deployment: All helpers and current-call generated indices remain inside kernel.asc using existing dav-2201 SDK; no new packages, build changes, additional kernels or cross-invocation cache.
